supersession_reason: The active GitHub Actions trigger plane was intentionally refactored from multiple independently-triggered workflow roots into one universal START.yml root. Provider-global checks must therefore bind to universally spawned core jobs in START rather than to archived legacy workflow paths.

workflow_scope_invariants: Exactly one active YAML workflow root MUST exist under .github/workflows.
The active START workflow MUST spawn for every pull request targeting main.
A provider-global required context MUST belong to a universally spawned START core job.
A conditional START lane MUST NOT be configured as a provider-global required check.
Archived legacy workflows are custody evidence and MUST NOT become active trigger roots.

negative_assurance_test.method: Use a bounded PR/fixture with one START core required check deliberately failing or the required review absent and observe provider refusal to merge without bypass.
negative_assurance_test.failure: provider permits merge despite required failure or absent required review

application_sequence: Re-read canonical main SHA and current provider protection/ruleset state.
Require an Administration:write-capable authorized surface and a rollback capsule before mutation.
Apply this v3 policy or an explicitly equivalent/stronger provider policy using only START core contexts listed in required_status_checks_global.
Immediately re-read provider state and bind exact protection/ruleset identifiers.
Exercise the bounded negative merge-rejection test.
Append a successor receipt; never rewrite v1, v2 or this prepared plan.
exit_criteria: authorized administrative surface applies equivalent or stronger provider policy
provider readback proves enforcement on canonical main
all provider-global required checks bind to universally spawned START core jobs
review and conversation-resolution requirements are observable
